postmortem.observation: HELIOT became stronger when the primary creative hierarchy shifted from product-style orbit/explosion language to a single architectural threshold/descent signature.
postmortem.action: Treat this as a project-specific lesson, not a rule for future architectural work. Future Director runs should retrieve the reasoning but penalize direct repetition of the same threshold mechanism.
